candidates.name: Inflammatory breast cancer
support_spans: a 3 × 3 cm palpable mass in the upper quadrant of the left breast
an ill-defined, deep retroareolar spiculated lesion measuring 3 × 1.5 cm with an early enhancement peak and associated architectural distortion
candidates.why: The patient presents with a palpable mass and a spiculated lesion on breast MRI, which are characteristic of inflammatory breast cancer.

candidates.name: Triple-negative breast cancer
support_spans: the epithelial cells were positive for cytokeratin AE1/E3 and negative for estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu
candidates.why: The immunohistochemical staining results are consistent with triple-negative breast cancer.

candidates.name: Medullary breast cancer

candidates.why: The presence of a dense lymphoid infiltrate is characteristic of medullary breast cancer.
